claim.claim-text: 1. A bispecific antibody comprising a first binding part specifically binding to human B cell maturation antigen (BCMA) and a second binding part specifically binding to human CD3ε (CD3) and an immunotherapeutic drug selected from the group consisting of thalidomide, lenalidomide, pomalidomide, CC-122, CC-220, an anti-CD38 antibody, an anti-PD-1 antibody and an anti-PD-L1 antibody, for use in treating multiple myeloma, wherein the first binding part comprises:

2. A bispecific antibody for use in the treatment of multiple myeloma, wherein the treatment comprises administering to a patient in need of such treatment a therapeutically effective amount of the bispecific antibody and an immunotherapeutic drug, wherein

b) the immunotherapeutic drug is selected from the group consisting of thalidomide, lenalidomide, pomalidomide, CC-122, CC-220, an anti-CD38 antibody, an anti-PD-1 antibody and an anti-PD-L1 antibody.

3. An immunotherapeutic drug for use in the treatment of multiple myeloma, wherein the treatment comprises administering to a patient in need of such treatment a therapeutically effective amount of the immunotherapeutic drug and a bispecific antibody, wherein

b) the immunotherapeutic drug is selected from the group consisting of thalidomide, lenalidomide, pomalidomide, CC-122, CC-220, an anti-CD38 antibody, an anti-PD-1 antibody and an anti-PD-L1 antibody.

4. The bispecific antibody and the immunotherapeutic drug for use according to claim 1, the bispecific antibody for use according to claim 2, or the immunotherapeutic drug for use according to claim 3, wherein the immunotherapeutic drug is selected from the group consisting of daratumumab, isatuximab, MOR202, Ab79, Ab19, pembrolizumab, pidilizumab, nivolumab, MEDI-0680, PDR001, REGN2810, lambrolizumab, MDX-1106, BGB-108, h409A11, h409A16, h409A17, atezolizumab, avelumab, durvalumab, and MDX-1105.

5. The bispecific antibody and the immunotherapeutic drug for use according to claim 1 or claim 4, the bispecific antibody for use according to claim 2 or claim 4, or the immunotherapeutic drug for use according to claim 3 or claim 4, wherein the bispecific antibody is administered subcutaneously.

6. A therapeutic combination for achieving multiple myeloma cell lysis in a patient suffering from multiple myeloma disease, wherein the therapeutic combination comprises a therapeutically effective amount of

a) a bispecific antibody comprising a first binding part specifically binding to human B cell maturation antigen (BCMA) and a second binding part specifically binding to human CD3ε (CD3), wherein the first binding part comprises: i) a VH region comprising a CDR1H region of SEQ ID NO:21, a CDR2H region of SEQ ID NO:22 and a CDR3H region of SEQ ID NO:17 and a VL region comprising a CDR1L region of SEQ ID NO:27, a CDR2L region of SEQ ID NO:28 and a CDR3L region of SEQ ID NO:20; ii) a VH region comprising a CDR1H region of SEQ ID NO:21, a CDR2H region of SEQ ID NO:22 and a CDR3H region of SEQ ID NO:17 and a VL region comprising a CDR1L region of SEQ ID NO:25, a CDR2L region of SEQ ID NO:26 and a CDR3L region of SEQ ID NO:20; iii) a VH region comprising a CDR1H region of SEQ ID NO:21, a CDR2H region of SEQ ID NO:22 and a CDR3H region of SEQ ID NO:17 and a VL region comprising a CDR1L region of SEQ ID NO:23, a CDR2L region of SEQ ID NO:24 and a CDR3L region of SEQ ID NO:20; or iv) a VH region comprising a CDR1H region of SEQ ID NO:15, a CDR2H region of SEQ ID NO:16 and a CDR3H region of SEQ ID NO:17 and a VL region comprising a CDR1L region of SEQ ID NO:18, a CDR2L region of SEQ ID NO:19, and a CDR3L region of SEQ ID NO:20, and b) an immunotherapeutic drug selected from the group consisting of thalidomide, lenalidomide, pomalidomide, CC-122, CC-220, an anti-CD38 antibody, an anti-PD-1 antibody and an anti-PD-L1 antibody.

7. The therapeutic combination according to claim 6, wherein the immunotherapeutic drug is selected from the group consisting of daratumumab, isatuximab, MOR202, Ab79, Ab19, pembrolizumab, pidilizumab, nivolumab, MEDI-0680, PDR001, REGN2810, lambrolizumab, MDX-1106, BGB-108, h409A11, h409A16, h409A17, atezolizumab, avelumab, durvalumab, and MDX-1105.
8. An article of manufacture, comprising

b) an immunotherapeutic drug selected from the group consisting of thalidomide, lenalidomide, pomalidomide, CC-122, CC-220, an anti-CD38 antibody, an anti-PD-1 antibody and an anti-PD-L1 antibody, and c) a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier and instructions for administering said bispecific antibody and said immunotherapeutic drug in combination to a subject in need of a treatment for multiple myeloma.

9. The article of manufacture according to claim 8, wherein the immunotherapeutic drug is selected from the group consisting of daratumumab, isatuximab, MOR202, Ab79, Ab19, pembrolizumab, pidilizumab, nivolumab, MEDI-0680, PDR001, REGN2810, lambrolizumab, MDX-1106, BGB-108, h409A11, h409A16, h409A17, atezolizumab, avelumab, durvalumab, and MDX-1105.
10. A method for manufacturing a medicament, wherein the method comprises using a therapeutically effective amount of

a) a bispecific antibody comprising a first binding part specifically binding to human B cell maturation antigen (BCMA) and a second binding part specifically binding to human CD3ε (CD3), wherein the first binding part comprises: i) a VH region comprising a CDR1H region of SEQ ID NO:21, a CDR2H region of SEQ ID NO:22 and a CDR3H region of SEQ ID NO:17 and a VL region comprising a CDR1L region of SEQ ID NO:27, a CDR2L region of SEQ ID NO:28 and a CDR3L region of SEQ ID NO:20; ii) a VH region comprising a CDR1H region of SEQ ID NO:21, a CDR2H region of SEQ ID NO:22 and a CDR3H region of SEQ ID NO:17 and a VL region comprising a CDR1L region of SEQ ID NO:25, a CDR2L region of SEQ ID NO:26 and a CDR3L region of SEQ ID NO:20; iii) a VH region comprising a CDR1H region of SEQ ID NO:21, a CDR2H region of SEQ ID NO:22 and a CDR3H region of SEQ ID NO:17 and a VL region comprising a CDR1L region of SEQ ID NO:23, a CDR2L region of SEQ ID NO:24 and a CDR3L region of SEQ ID NO:20; or iv) a VH region comprising a CDR1H region of SEQ ID NO:15, a CDR2H region of SEQ ID NO:16 and a CDR3H region of SEQ ID NO:17 and a VL region comprising a CDR1L region of SEQ ID NO:18, a CDR2L region of SEQ ID NO:19, and a CDR3L region of SEQ ID NO:20, and b) an immunotherapeutic drug selected from the group consisting of thalidomide, lenalidomide, pomalidomide, CC-122, CC-220, an anti-CD38 antibody, an anti-PD-1 antibody and an anti-PD-L1 antibody, and combining said bispecific antibody and said immunotherapeutic drug in a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier.

11. The method according to claim 10, wherein the immunotherapeutic drug is selected from the group consisting of daratumumab, isatuximab, MOR202, Ab79, Ab19, pembrolizumab, pidilizumab, nivolumab, MEDI-0680, PDR001, REGN2810, lambrolizumab, MDX-1106, BGB-108, h409A11, h409A16, h409A17, atezolizumab, avelumab, durvalumab, and MDX-1105.

12. The bispecific antibody and the immunotherapeutic drug for use according to any one of claims 1, 4 or 5, the bispecific antibody for use according to any one of claims 2, 4 or 5, the immunotherapeutic drug for use according to any one of claims 3-5, the therapeutic combination according to claim 6 or claim 7, the article of manufacture according to claim 8 or claim 9, or the method according to claim 10 or claim 11, wherein the first binding part of the bispecific antibody comprises a VH region comprising a CDR1H region of SEQ ID NO:21, a CDR2H region of SEQ ID NO:22 and a CDR3H region of SEQ ID NO:17 and a VL region comprising a CDR1L region of SEQ ID NO:27, a CDR2L region of SEQ ID NO:28 and a CDR3L region of SEQ ID NO:20; and the immunotherapeutic drug is CC-220 or lenalidomide.

13. The bispecific antibody and the immunotherapeutic drug for use according to any one of claims 1, 4, 5 or 12, the bispecific antibody for use according to any one of claims 2, 4, 5 or 12, the immunotherapeutic drug for use according to any one of claims 3-5 or 12, the therapeutic combination according to any one of claims 6, 7 or 12, the article of manufacture according to any one of claims 8, 9 or 12, or the method according to any one of claims 10-12, wherein the first binding part of the bispecific antibody comprises a VH region of SEQ ID NO: 10 and a VL region of SEQ ID NO: 14.

14. The bispecific antibody and the immunotherapeutic drug for use according to any one of claims 1, 4, 5, 12 or 13, the bispecific antibody for use according to any one of claims 2, 4, 5, 12 or 13, the immunotherapeutic drug for use according to any one of claims 3-5, 12 or 13, the therapeutic combination according to any one of claims 6, 7, 12 or 13, the article of manufacture according to any one of claims 8, 9, 12 or 13, or the method according to any one of claims 10-13, wherein the bispecific antibody comprises a heavy and light chain set consisting of polypeptides SEQ ID NO:48, SEQ ID NO:55, SEQ ID NO:56, and two copies of SEQ ID NO:57.
